an9.8:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
an9.8:1.2: athakho sajjho paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
an9.8:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho sajjho paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an9.8:2.1: ekamidāhaṃ bhante samayaṃ bhagavā idheva rājagahe viharāmi giribbaje
an9.8:2.2: tatra me bhante bhagavato sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
an9.8:2.3: yo so sajjha bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññāvimutto abhabbo so pañcaṭṭhānāni ajjhācarituṃ

an9.8:2.5: kacci metaṃ bhante bhagavato sussutaṃ suggahitaṃ sumanasikataṃ sūpadhāritanti.
